title: Connection Arcade
unlocks: themed question decks, wheel designs and conversation categories

games.name: Guess My Answer
games.how: Spin a question. One of you guesses how the other will answer, then reveal.
games.teaches: Curiosity about each other keeps connection alive.

games.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
games.how: Pass the phone and play noughts and crosses.
games.teaches: A two-minute warm-up that gets you both laughing.

games.name: Four in a Row
games.how: Drop discs, line up four. Pass and play.

games.name: How Well Do You Know Me?
games.teaches: Learn the small things that make your person them.

games.name: Love Language Match
games.how: Match each way of showing love to an everyday example.
games.teaches: People feel loved in different ways. Knowing your person's way changes everything.

games.name: Would You Rather?
games.how: Spin a dilemma, both answer, then defend your choice.

games.name: Finish the Sentence
games.how: Spin a sentence starter and finish it out loud.
games.teaches: Saying the nice thing out loud is a habit worth building.

games.name: Two Truths and a Lie
games.how: Spin a topic. Say two true things and one lie about it. They guess the lie.
games.teaches: You always have more to learn about each other.

games.name: This or That
games.how: Rapid-fire choices. Pick fast, compare after.

games.name: Deep Talk Roulette
games.how: Spin for a deeper question. Take your time; skip anything that doesn't feel right.
games.teaches: Big conversations build closeness. Go gently.
